title: World Simulation Workflow Validation
objective: Memvalidasi perjalanan, kalender, silsilah, peta temporal, diplomasi, kontinuitas tokoh, kekuatan, ekonomi, rumor, dan teknologi.

workflow_results.description: Setiap komponen world simulation menghasilkan output yang valid dan dapat dikonsumsi oleh langkah berikutnya.
components: journey_consistency (route existence, segment contiguity, time feasibility, supply check)
custom_calendar (dateFromTick round-trip, celestial cycles, season derivation)
genealogy_tree (builder roots, generations, ancestors, descendants, dynasty clusters)
temporal_map (territorial control layers, slider step, active controllers at tick)
diplomacy_history (treaty creation, active status, conflict detection)
age_continuity (character age at time, scene presence validation, continuity alerts)
economy_calculator (price comparison, purchasing power, wealth tier)
tech_tree (node creation, prerequisite check, discovery timeline, layout)

determinism_results.description: Semua komponen deterministik: input sama → output sama. Tidak ada random, wall clock, atau network.

explanation_results.description: Setiap komponen menyediakan penjelasan yang dapat dimengerti manusia.

override_results.description: Override dan edge case ditangani dengan benar: input kosong, batas negatif, siklus, duplikat.

limits: Native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, public release DEFERRED. Validation bersifat domain-only: exercised components are in-memory pure Dart, not wired to live database or UI.
